messages.subject: lavaanPlot: a CFA diagram for scalar invariant model
parts:
HI everyone,

I would like to plot the factor loadings (and nothing else, so no correlations, residual variances, etc.) of my scalar invariant model using lavaanPlot (I personally think they look better aesthetically than semPaths). However because my CFA has been computed across 7 groups, then lavaanPlot is failing. Of course, the factor loadings have been constrained to be the same across the 7 groups, so is there any way of subsetting the lavaan model object just for one group, and then feeding that in to lavaanPlot?

Thanks
Victoria
